# tuiOS-Prime

> Sistema Operacional de Linha de Comando — Kernel Rust bare-metal + ISO NixOS

[![Build Status](https://github.com/peder1981/tuiOS-Prime/workflows/Build%20e%20Testes/badge.svg)](https://github.com/peder1981/tuiOS-Prime/actions)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

## Instalação Rápida

```bash
git clone https://github.com/peder1981/tuiOS-Prime.git
cd tuiOS-Prime
just image
just qemu-kernel
```

## Chromebook Support

O tuiOS-Prime é otimizado para Chromebooks com hardware limitado:

- **Perfil Minimal**: 2GB RAM, Intel Atom/Celeron
- **Perfil Standard**: 4GB RAM, Intel Core m/Pentium
- **Perfil Performance**: 8GB+ RAM, Intel Core i5/i7
